title: From Memory Hits to Answerable Evidence: Query-Conditioned Memory Compilation for Long-Term Agent Memory

paragraphs.en: Long-term agent memory requires recovering answer-relevant evidence dispersed across turns and sessions. Existing systems increasingly use structured memories and adaptive retrieval, yet often pass retrieved or expanded units directly to the reader, coupling memory addressing with evidence presentation and leaving the final context redundant or incomplete. To address this gap, we propose MemCompile, a query-conditioned evidence compilation framework for long-term conversational memory. Given a query, the Address Plane locates relevant support through compact source-linked descriptors and capacity-aware Cells, while a normalization boundary resolves heterogeneous retrieval hits to stable SourcePacket identities. Its Evidence Plane then allocates a bounded evidence budget across complementary packets, admits limited additional support, and renders the retained claims associated with each selected packet into an answer-ready context. MemCompile achieves 80.52% Judge Accuracy on LoCoMo and extends the empirical quality–cost Pareto frontier to a higher-quality regime. Its strong performance on LongMemEval-S further suggests that the benefits of query-conditioned compilation generalize across long-term conversational-memory benchmarks. The implementation code is publicly available at https://github.com/MINE-USTC/MemCompile
paragraphs.zh: 长期智能体记忆需要恢复分散在不同回合和会话中的与答案相关的证据。 现有系统越来越多地使用结构化记忆和自适应检索，但通常将检索或扩展后的单元直接传递给阅读器，导致记忆寻址与证据呈现相互耦合，并使最终上下文冗余或不完整。 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 MemCompile——一个面向长期对话记忆的查询条件化证据编译框架。 给定一个查询，地址平面通过紧凑的源链接描述符和容量感知的单元定位相关支持，同时归一化边界将异构检索结果转化为稳定的源包标识。 其证据平面随后在互补数据包中分配有限的证据预算，允许有限数量的额外支持加入，并将保留的断言与每个选定的数据包关联，生成可用于回答的上下文。 MemCompile 在 LoCoMo 数据集上实现了 80.52% 的 Judge Accuracy，并将经验性的质量-成本帕累托前沿扩展到了更高质量的区域。 它在 LongMemEval-S 上的优异表现进一步表明，查询条件化编译的优势能够泛化到各种长期对话记忆基准测试中。 实现代码可在 https://github.com/MINE-USTC/MemCompile 公开获取。

paragraphs.en: Long-term memory is essential for interactive agents to sustain coherent, personalized, and reliable behavior across sessions. By carrying forward user preferences, past events, commitments, and evolving states, it allows an agent to respond in light of what has happened before Maharana et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2025) . However, the information needed for a new query may be distributed across distant turns and sessions or revised by later interactions. Persistent interaction therefore depends not only on retaining past information, but also on making the relevant parts of an accumulated history accessible when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 长期记忆对于交互式智能体而言至关重要，它能使智能体在不同会话中保持连贯、个性化且可靠的行为。 通过保留用户偏好、过往事件、承诺以及不断变化的状态，智能体能够基于此前发生的情况作出回应 Maharana et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2025) 。 然而，新查询所需的信息可能分散在相隔较远的对话轮次和会话中，也可能因后续互动而发生变化。 因此，持续性的交互不仅依赖于对过往信息的保留，还取决于在需要时能够访问累积历史中的相关部分。

paragraphs.en: Foundational long-term memory systems addressed this need by extracting and retrieving salient records, including persistent memories and atomic conversational facts Zhong et al. (2023) ; Chhikara et al. (2025) . Subsequent work improved access by compressing dialogue into facts, notes, summaries, profiles, and events, and by organizing these representations in graphs or hierarchies Xu et al. (2025) ; Rasmussen et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) ; Yao et al. (2026) . As retrieval representations became increasingly compact and structured, recent work began to distinguish the units used to locate memory from the evidence exposed to the reader. AnchorMem reconstructs immutable contexts from retrieved fact anchors, xMemory adaptively discloses segments or raw messages from a hierarchy, and MemIR projects heterogeneous retrieval cues into provenance-scoped claim bundles Shen et al. (2026) ; Hu et al. (2026) ; Jin et al. (2026) . Together, these developments move long-term memory systems from improving addressability toward separating memory location from evidence presentation.

paragraphs.en: However, this separation remains incomplete: the retrieved representation, or the expansion attached to it, still largely determines the context presented to the reader. Existing systems therefore do not fully separate two decisions: which underlying conversation sources should receive the limited evidence budget, and how evidence from those sources should be represented for answer generation. This coupling is problematic because the two decisions favor different properties. Address representations should be compact, discriminative, and broad enough to support reliable recall, whereas reader evidence should preserve relevant qualifications, connect complementary facts, and avoid unnecessary context. When a single unit serves both purposes, the system must accept a fixed trade-off. As illustrated in Figure 1 , an atomic claim may be easy to retrieve but may omit causal relationships or sibling facts from the same source. A raw turn preserves such details but may reintroduce noise, such as greetings and irrelevant dialogue, whereas a hierarchy node can provide an effective navigation unit without matching the granularity required for answer generation. Moreover, without an explicit source-level boundary, multiple claims or retrieval channels may allocate context budget repeatedly to the same underlying source. This coupling not only creates avoidable quality loss after successful retrieval, but also makes it difficult to distinguish failures of source recovery from failures of evidence presentation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种分离仍然不完全：检索到的表示或附加在其上的扩展内容，在很大程度上仍决定呈现给读者的上下文。 因此，现有系统并未完全区分两个决策：哪些底层的对话来源应获得有限的证据配额，以及这些来源的证据应如何表示以用于答案生成。 这种耦合存在问题，因为这两个决策所偏好的特性不同。 地址表示应当紧凑、具有区分性，并且足够广泛以支持可靠的召回；而读者证据则应保留相关限定条件、连接互补事实，并避免不必要的上下文。 当一个单一单元同时承担这两种功能时，系统就必须接受一种固定的权衡。 如图 1 所示，一个原子性主张可能易于检索，但可能会遗漏来自同一来源的因果关系或并列事实。 原始对话回合保留了这些细节，但可能重新引入噪声，例如问候语和无关对话；而层次结构节点虽然能提供一个有效的导航单元，却可能与答案生成所需的粒度不匹配。 此外，如果没有明确的来源级边界，多个主张或检索通道可能会重复地将上下文配额分配给同一个底层来源。 这种耦合不仅会在成功检索后造成本可避免的质量损失，还使得难以区分来源恢复的失败与证据呈现的失败。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose MemCompile, a source-normalized evidence compiler for long-term conversational memory. Its central principle is to locate relevant information through compact representations and allocate the evidence budget at the level of original dialogue turns while generating from a separately compiled reader view. MemCompile realizes this principle through an Address–Evidence two-plane architecture. The Address Plane organizes source-linked atomic descriptors into capacity-bounded Cells and combines diminishing-benefit Cell routing with lexical retrieval to construct primary source candidates while a broader dense packet pool supplies proposals for bounded semantic refinement. An explicit normalization boundary resolves these heterogeneous results to stable SourcePacket identities, ensuring that one underlying source occupies one evidence unit regardless of how many descriptors or channels locate it. The Evidence Plane then selects complementary packet identities, preserves the initial anchors while admitting bounded additional support, completes evidence within each selected packet, and compiles the result into a reader-facing view. By separating packet selection from textual rendering, MemCompile can optimize and evaluate source recovery and evidence presentation as distinct decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 MemCompile，这是一种用于长期对话记忆的原语归一化证据编译器。 其核心原则是通过紧凑的表示形式定位相关信息，并在从独立编译的读者视角生成内容时，以原始对话轮次为单位分配证据预算。 MemCompile 通过“地址–证据”双平面架构实现了这一原则。 地址平面将源链接的原子描述符组织为容量受限的单元，并将收益递减的单元路由与词汇检索相结合，以构建初步的源候选项；同时，一个更广泛的密集数据包池则为有限的语义精炼提供提案。 一个显式的归一化边界将这些异构结果转化为稳定的源数据包身份，确保无论有多少描述符或通道定位到某个基础源，该源始终占用一个证据单元。 随后，证据平面会选择互补的数据包身份，在保留初始锚点的同时允许有限数量的额外支持，在每个选定的数据包内完成证据构建，并将最终结果编译为面向读者的视图。 通过将数据包选择与文本渲染分离，MemCompile 能够将源恢复和证据呈现作为两个独立的决策进行优化与评估。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We formulate long-term memory serving as query-conditioned evidence compilation, distinguishing two decisions that are commonly coupled: which underlying sources receive the evidence budget and how evidence from those sources is represented to the reader.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将长期记忆构建为一种以查询为条件的证据编译机制，并区分了两个通常相互耦合的决策：哪些底层来源应获得证据预算，以及如何将这些来源的证据呈现给读者。

paragraphs.en: We introduce MemCompile, an Address–Evidence two-plane architecture that addresses memory through compact derived views, allocates evidence budget at the level of immutable SourcePackets, and generates from a separately compiled reader view.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MemCompile，这是一种“地址–证据”双平面架构。它通过紧凑的派生视图来访问内存，在不可变的 SourcePacket 层级分配证据预算，并基于独立编译的读取视图生成结果。

paragraphs.en: Comprehensive evaluations on long-term memory benchmarks demonstrate that MemCompile consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while extending the empirical quality–cost Pareto frontier. On the LoCoMo benchmark, packet-scoped compilation improves F1 by 15.26 points and Judge Accuracy by 23.51 points over representative-claim rendering.

paragraphs.en: Recent systems recognize that a representation useful for locating memory need not be self-contained answer evidence. AnchorMem retrieves atomic facts as anchors and reconstructs their associated raw contexts and events Shen et al. (2026) . xMemory organizes intact memory units into a revisable hierarchy and adaptively discloses episodes or raw messages when additional detail reduces reader uncertainty Hu et al. (2026) . MemIR takes a typed approach, separating raw evidence, retrieval cues, and truth-bearing claims, and projecting heterogeneous hits into provenance-scoped claim bundles exposed through a normalized fact interface Jin et al. (2026) . MemCompile builds on the shared insight that retrieval representations and answer evidence serve different purposes, but places its architectural boundary at a different level. MemCompile instead resolves derived address results to immutable SourcePacket identities before evidence selection. This source-normalized boundary makes it possible to vary and evaluate reader representation while holding the selected source set fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的系统认识到，用于定位记忆的表示形式不必是自包含的答案证据。 AnchorMem 以原子事实作为锚点进行检索，并重构与之相关的原始上下文和事件 Shen et al. (2026)。 xMemory 将完整的记忆单元组织成可修订的层级结构，并在额外细节减少读者不确定性时，自适应地揭示事件或原始信息 Hu et al. paragraphs.en: We evaluate MemCompile on LoCoMo Maharana et al. (2024) and LongMemEval Wu et al. (2025) benchmarks. LoCoMo evaluates long-term conversational memory over extended, multi-session dialogues which contains ten conversations, each comprising roughly 600 dialogue turns and 16K tokens on average. LongMemEval-s evaluates the ability of chat assistants to retain and use information across sustained user-assistant interactions, which contains 500 questions, each embedded in a history of approximately 115K tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 LoCoMo Maharana et al. (2024) 和 LongMemEval Wu et al. (2025) 基准数据集上对 MemCompile 进行了评估。LoCoMo 评估智能体在长时间、多轮次对话中的长期对话记忆能力，该数据集包含十段对话，每段对话平均约有 600 个对话回合和 16K 个词元。LongMemEval-s 则评估聊天助手在持续的用户-助手互动中保留和使用信息的能力，该数据集包含 500 个问题，每个问题都嵌入在约 115K 个词元的历史记录中。

paragraphs.en: On LoCoMo, Table 1 shows that MemCompile ranks first on all reported single-hop, multi-hop, and temporal metrics and obtains the best overall F1/BLEU/Judge scores of 55.94/48.65/80.52 . Besides the dominant performance on Single-Hop, MemCompile achieves substantial improvements over the strongest baseline on Multi-Hop and Temporal, increasing the J score by 8.69 and 7.79 percentage points. This consistent enhancement across direct, compositional, and time-sensitive queries confirms the effectiveness of separating multi-view addressing from source-budgeted evidence compilation: source normalization preserves precise direct recall, while complementary scheduling and packet-scoped rendering remain effective when evidence is distributed across sources or time. Figure 3 illustrates the corresponding quality-cost trade-off. Compared with Mem0, MemCompile improves Judge by 14.35 points while using 51.7% fewer tokens (26.72M vs. 55.30M). AtomMem provides the closest cost comparison: MemCompile uses only 8.8% more tokens (26.72M vs. 24.55M), yet improves overall Judge by 10.01 points. Thus, although MemCompile does not minimize absolute token usage, it converts a moderate computational budget into substantially higher answer quality and extends the empirical frontier to 80.52% Judge. The detailed per phase cost accounting is in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 在 LoCoMo 中，表 1 显示 MemCompile 在所有报告的单跳、多跳和时间相关指标上均排名第一，并获得了最高的综合 F1/BLEU/Judge 分数：55.94/48.65/80.52。 除了在单跳任务中的卓越表现，MemCompile 在多跳和时间相关任务上也比最强的基线模型实现了显著提升，将 J 分数分别提高了 8.69 和 7.79 个百分点。 这种在直接、组合和时间敏感查询中的一致性提升，证实了将多视角寻址与源预算证据编译分离的有效性：源归一化保留了精确的直接召回能力，而当证据分布在不同来源或时间上时，互补的调度和包级渲染仍然有效。 图 3 展示了相应的质量-成本权衡关系。 与 Mem0 相比，MemCompile 在 Judge 分数上提升了 14.35 分，同时使用的 token 数量减少了 51.7%（26.72M 对比 55.30M）。 AtomMem 提供了最接近的成本对比：MemCompile 仅使用了 8.8% 更多的 token（26.72M 对比 24.55M），但整体 Judge 分数提升了 10.01 分。 因此，尽管 MemCompile 并未最小化绝对 token 使用量，但它将适度的计算预算转化为了显著更高的答案质量，并将经验边界扩展到了 80.52% 的 Judge 分数。 各阶段的详细成本核算见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: We introduced MemCompile, an Address-Evidence dual-plane architecture that separates memory location from reader-facing compilation. The Address Plane improves addressing and memory placement through organizing source-linked atomic descriptors in bounded Cells. Source normalization then releases duplicate address slot by resolving cross-channel hits to its SourcePacket key; the Evidence Plane schedules complementary sources, preserves initial anchors during bounded expansion, and compiles packet-scoped claims. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark confirm that MemCompile achieves state-of-the-art performance while the result on LongMemEval-S demonstrates strong cross-benchmark performance. Ultimately, MemCompile offers a source-normalized and cost-effective evidence-compilation framework for deploying intelligent agents capable of sustaining reliable, evidence-grounded long-term interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MemCompile，这是一种地址-证据双平面架构，它将内存位置与面向读取者的编译过程分离开来。 地址平面通过在有限的单元中组织与源数据关联的原子描述符，从而改进地址指定和内存布局。 随后，源数据归一化通过解决跨通道命中问题并将其映射到源数据包键，释放重复的地址槽；证据平面则安排互补的源数据，在有限扩展过程中保留初始锚点，并编译数据包范围内的声明。 在 LoCoMo 基准测试上的实验证实，MemCompile 实现了当前最先进的性能，而其在 LongMemEval-S 上的结果也展现了强大的跨基准测试性能。 最终，MemCompile 提供了一个经过源数据归一化且成本效益高的证据编译框架，可用于部署能够维持可靠、基于证据的长期交互的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 specifies the complete serving path. The construction stage creates one immutable SourcePacket per dialogue turn, extracts an ordered set of atomic descriptors, records a foreign key from each descriptor to its packet, and places the descriptors into bounded Cells. At query time, query-only intent fields augment the lexical query. Cell routing and BM25 produce atomic candidates, which are collapsed by SourcePacket identity before listwise scheduling. The semantic frontier operates over a separate packet index and can only append packets to the scheduled anchors. Finally, the reader view is materialized without changing the selected packet sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 指定了完整的服务路径。 构建阶段为每个对话回合创建一个不可更改的 SourcePacket，提取一个有序的原子描述符集合，记录每个描述符到其数据包的外键，并将这些描述符放入有界的 Cell 中。 在查询时，仅用于查询的意图字段会补充词汇查询。 Cell 路由和 BM25 生成原子候选项，这些候选项在列表式调度前通过 SourcePacket 标识进行合并。 语义前沿在独立的数据包索引上运行，并且只能向已调度的锚点追加数据包。 最后，阅读器视图在不变动所选数据包序列的情况下被具体化。

paragraphs.en: Atomic candidates are grouped by their stored source_packet_id . Within each group, the descriptor with the largest retrieval score becomes the representative address; ties retain the earliest candidate. Packet ordering is then descending by the representative score, followed by first candidate position and packet identifier. This operation changes the selection state from claims to sources without adding any source absent from the closed candidate pool.
paragraphs.zh: 原子候选项根据其存储的 source_packet_id 进行分组。 在每个组内，检索得分最高的描述符将成为代表地址；若出现并列，则保留最早的候选项。 随后，数据包排序将按代表得分降序排列，其次为第一个候选项的位置和数据包标识符。 此操作会将选择状态从“声明”更改为“源”，但不会添加任何未包含在封闭候选池中的源。

paragraphs.en: For every new item, all capacity-feasible existing Cells compete with a new Cell under the placement objective in Eq. 4 . The resulting organization jointly reflects person and keyword locality, session proximity, coherence, conflict avoidance, capacity, and entropy pressure. The policy is deterministic and accumulative, not a gradient-trained clustering model. The bouned cell layout improves recall by 3.959 points.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个新项，所有容量可行的现有单元都会根据公式 4 中的布局目标与一个新单元展开竞争。 由此形成的组织结构同时体现了人员和关键词的局部性、会话邻近性、连贯性、冲突规避、容量以及熵压力。 该策略是确定性的且具有累积性，并非通过梯度训练得到的聚类模型。 有界单元布局将召回率提升了 3.959 分。

paragraphs.en: Sequential orders items by session index and then by dialogue identifier within each session order, and partitions the resulting sequence into fixed-length contiguous blocks. It discards people, keywords, coherence, and conflict signals, retaining only dialogue adjacency. This layout tests whether simple sequential locality accounts for the Cell benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 按会话索引对项进行顺序排列，然后在每个会话顺序内按对话标识符排序，并将生成的序列划分为固定长度的连续块。 它丢弃了人物、关键词、连贯性和冲突信号，仅保留对话的相邻性。 这种布局旨在检验简单的序列局部性是否能够解释 Cell 效应。

paragraphs.en: Session first groups items by session index, preserves their within-session order, and partitions each session independently into fixed-length blocks. Comparing Session with Sequential therefore isolates the value of the dataset’s session boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: Session 首先按会话索引对项进行分组，保留其会话内的顺序，并将每个会话独立划分为固定长度的块。 因此，将 Session 与 Sequential 进行比较，可以明确数据集的会话边界所具有的价值。

paragraphs.en: Entity assigns each item to a bucket keyed by its primary person entity, orders each bucket by dialogue order, and partitions it into fixed-length blocks. It tests person identity as a cross-turn and cross-session address without using the complete placement objective. Entity layout improves the recall by 2.910 points. The result identifies person locality as a useful but incomplete component of the persistent organization.
paragraphs.zh: 该实体将每个项目分配到一个以其主要人物实体为键的桶中，按对话顺序对每个桶进行排序，并将其划分为固定长度的块。 它在跨回合和跨会话的地址中测试人物身份，而无需使用完整的定位目标。 实体布局使召回率提高了 2.910 分。 该结果表明，人物局部性是持久化组织中一个有用但不完整的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: The LoCoMo evaluation contains 1,540 questions from ten conversations and retains the benchmark’s single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, and open-domain categories. Memory construction receives conversation sessions only. Query text is exposed to query-intent extraction and retrieval at evaluation time; answers, question categories, gold evidence, and judge labels are not inputs to construction, addressing, scheduling, frontier selection and answer generation. Evaluation is read-only with respect to persistent memory state.
paragraphs.zh: LoCoMo 评估包含来自十次对话的 1,540 个问题，并保留了该基准的单跳、多跳、时序和开放领域类别。 记忆构建仅接收对话会话。 在评估时，查询文本会提供给查询意图提取和检索；但答案、问题类别、黄金证据和评判标签不会作为输入用于构建、处理、调度、前沿选择和答案生成。 评估过程对持久化记忆状态而言是只读的。

sents.en: Query text is exposed to query-intent extraction and retrieval at evaluation time; answers, question categories, gold evidence, and judge labels are not inputs to construction, addressing, scheduling, frontier selection and answer generation.

paragraphs.en: Each packet document concatenates raw turn text, image caption and query fields when present, all retained packet claims, packet-level people and keywords, and the recorded session time. Documents and the enriched query are embedded and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized; cosine similarity is therefore a matrix–vector dot product. The enriched query concatenates the question with query-only people, keywords, and time. The semantic Top-40 is united with the ten scheduled anchors by dialogue identifier. A second closed-pool listwise schedule orders this union. All ten anchors are preserved, and at most two previously unselected packets among the first five scheduled positions are appended.
paragraphs.zh: 每个数据包文档在存在相关字段时，会将原始对话文本、图片说明和查询字段连接起来，同时保留所有数据包声明、数据包级人物和关键词，以及记录好的会话时间。 文档和增强后的查询会被嵌入并进行 ℓ₂（ℓ₂）归一化；因此，余弦相似度就是一个矩阵与向量的点积运算。 增强后的查询会将问题与仅属于查询的人物、关键词和时间连接起来。 语义 Top-40 列表通过对话标识符与十个预定锚点合并。 第二个封闭池的列表式调度会对这个合并结果进行排序。 所有十个锚点都会被保留，并且最多会追加五个预定位置中此前未被选中的两个数据包。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows the interaction between the rank cutoff K R K_{R} and append cap K Δ K_{\Delta} . When K Δ = 0 K_{\Delta}=0 , all curves coincide because no frontier proposal can enter the final evidence set. For K R = 1 K_{R}=1 , increasing the cap beyond one has no effect by construction. Larger rank windows make more frontier proposals eligible, but for K R ∈ { 3 , 5 } K_{R}\in\{3,5\} most of the observed coverage gain is obtained by K Δ = 2 K_{\Delta}=2 . In contrast, K R = 10 K_{R}=10 continues to benefit from larger append caps, indicating that a wider rank window is useful mainly when more context growth is permitted.

paragraphs.en: At the fixed setting ( K R , K Δ ) = ( 5 , 2 ) (K_{R},K_{\Delta})=(5,2) , mean Gold Source Recall reaches 85.50%, with 1,217 questions achieving complete gold-source coverage. paragraphs.en: LongMemEval examples are converted into the same neutral session/turn schema used by LoCoMo. Each official haystack session retains its identifier and date; each turn receives a stable identifier formed from the session ID and turn position. The system constructs a separate memory for each evaluation instance and applies the same source-linked descriptor, Cell routing, SourcePacket scheduling, semantic frontier, and reader compilation pipeline. The official question types comprise single-session user, single-session assistant, single-session preference, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and multi-session questions. Answer-session and turn-level evidence labels are used only for offline evidence evaluation. On LongMemEval-S, MemCompile achieves the best Judge Accuracy among the evaluated methods in five of the six reported categories: single-session user (91.43%), temporal reasoning (72.18%), knowledge update (78.21%), single-session assistant (94.64%), and single-session preference (70.00%). Table 7 reports the full category-level results.
paragraphs.zh: LongMemEval 的示例被转换为 LoCoMo 使用的相同中立会话/轮次结构。 每个官方 haystack 会话都保留其标识符和日期；每个轮次都会获得一个由会话 ID 和轮次位置构成的稳定标识符。 系统为每个评估实例构建独立的记忆，并应用相同的源链接描述符、Cell 路由、SourcePacket 调度、语义前沿和读者编译流程。 官方问题类型包括单会话用户问题、单会话助手问题、单会话偏好问题、时序推理问题、知识更新问题和多会话问题。 答案-会话和轮次级证据标签仅用于离线证据评估。 在 LongMemEval-S 上，MemCompile 在六个报告类别中的五个中取得了所评估方法中最高的 Judge Accuracy：单会话用户（91.43%）、时序推理（72.18%）、知识更新（78.21%）、单会话助手（94.64%）和单会话偏好（70.00%）。 表 7 报告了完整的类别级结果。

paragraphs.en: Successful LLM responses are stored under an identity containing the system prompt, user request, response format, model, temperature, maximum completion length, and call type. A cache hit contributes zero incremental tokens to the current invocation. Durable usage is reconstructed from unique successful cache entries, preventing both double counting after replay and omission when an API response is committed before the coordinating checkpoint. Embedding requests use a separate identity-addressed cache and an idempotent usage ledger. Packet scheduler caches additionally bind the ordered candidate tensor and rendered packet content hashes.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的 LLM 响应会存储在一个身份标识下，该标识包含系统提示、用户请求、响应格式、模型、温度、最大完成长度和调用类型。 缓存命中不会为当前调用贡献任何增量令牌。 持久性使用量由唯一的成功缓存条目重构而成，从而防止重放后的重复计数，也避免在 API 响应在协调检查点之前提交时出现遗漏。 嵌入请求使用一个独立的身份标识关联的缓存和一个幂等的使用量账本。 数据包调度器缓存还会绑定有序的候选张量以及渲染后的数据包内容哈希值。

paragraphs.en: Cold construction accounts for 14.07M tokens, or 52.7% of non-Judge usage, and is amortized across subsequent questions over the same conversation. Online serving accounts for the remaining 12.65M tokens. Within serving, the R2 packet scheduler and E0.7 frontier reranker consume 10.55M tokens in total, equivalent to 39.5% of the end-to-end total (and 83.4% of online usage). These two stages are therefore the principal online cost paid for packet-level selection and progressive evidence compilation; query-intent extraction and answer generation together account for the remaining 7.9% of the total.

paragraphs.en: Fact extraction uses the following system message exactly: Its user request supplies the preceding turn when present, followed by the current dialogue identifier, speaker, session time, text, and available image caption or image keywords. Metadata extraction supplies the standalone fact, preceding turn, current turn, and session time. Query-intent extraction supplies only the query. For both packet schedulers, the dynamic request uses the candidate format [C###] dia_id=... speaker=... recorded_date=... content="..." and explicitly requests the exact output cardinality. Answer generation supplies the query and the materialized evidence blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 事实提取严格使用以下系统消息：其用户请求在存在时提供前一个回合的内容，随后是当前对话标识符、发言人、会话时间、文本以及可用的图像标题或图像关键词。 元数据提取提供独立的事实、前一个回合、当前回合和会话时间。 查询意图提取仅提供查询本身。 对于两种数据包调度器，动态请求均使用候选格式 [C###] dia_id=... speaker=... recorded_date=... content="..."，并明确指定所需的精确输出数量。 答案生成提供查询和已具象化的证据块。

sents.en: Fact extraction uses the following system message exactly: Its user request supplies the preceding turn when present, followed by the current dialogue identifier, speaker, session time, text, and available image caption or image keywords.
sents.zh: 事实提取严格使用以下系统消息：其用户请求在存在时提供前一个回合的内容，随后是当前对话标识符、发言人、会话时间、文本以及可用的图像标题或图像关键词。

sents.en: Metadata extraction supplies the standalone fact, preceding turn, current turn, and session time.
sents.zh: 元数据提取提供独立的事实、前一个回合、当前回合和会话时间。

sents.en: Query-intent extraction supplies only the query.
sents.zh: 查询意图提取仅提供查询本身。

sents.en: For both packet schedulers, the dynamic request uses the candidate format [C###] dia_id=... speaker=... recorded_date=... content="..." and explicitly requests the exact output cardinality.
sents.zh: 对于两种数据包调度器，动态请求均使用候选格式 [C###] dia_id=... speaker=... recorded_date=... content="..."，并明确指定所需的精确输出数量。

sents.en: Answer generation supplies the query and the materialized evidence blocks.
sents.zh: 答案生成提供查询和已具象化的证据块。

paragraphs.en: JSON responses are parsed directly and, when a provider wraps a requested list in a generic object, the parser accepts the corresponding schema alias. Packet scheduler outputs additionally undergo exact cardinality, uniqueness, and closed-label validation. Judge responses are parsed into the two permitted labels after substituting the question, gold answer, and generated answer into Prompt .
paragraphs.zh: JSON 响应会被直接解析；当提供商将请求的列表封装在通用对象中时，解析器会接受相应的模式别名。 数据包调度器的输出还会经过精确的基数、唯一性和封闭标签验证。 在将问题、标准答案和生成答案代入提示后，裁判响应会被解析为两个允许的标签。
